product_updates.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
product_updates.content: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.

product_updates.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
product_updates.content: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman…

product_updates.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
product_updates.content: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

product_updates.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
product_updates.content: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

product_updates.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
product_updates.content: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

product_updates.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
product_updates.content: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

product_updates.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
product_updates.content: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

product_updates.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
product_updates.content: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

product_updates.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
product_updates.content: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

product_updates.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
product_updates.content: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

technical_breakthroughs.content: A researcher says attacks chaining 4 vulnerabilities is hacking unpatched boxes.

technical_breakthroughs.content: ReactOS gains NTFS install support with new driver.
